recipes.name: Roast carrots with garlic and rosemary

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve {{ing:carrot-medium}} lengthways.
Toss in a roasting tin with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-rosemary}}.
Roast 35 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.

Squeeze over {{ing:lime}}.

Toss in a roasting tin with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Roast 35 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Grate over {{ing:parmesan}} for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Roast chicken with lemon and thyme

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Pat {{ing:chicken-whole}} dry. Rub with {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Sit on {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 1 hour 20 minutes, until the juices run clear.
Rest under foil 15 minutes before carving.
steps.note: Resting lets the juices settle back in.

Sit on {{ing:onion-large}} and {{ing:apple-medium}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 30 minutes. Turn the oven down to 170C.
Roast for the rest of 3 hours, until the meat is tender and the skin crackles.
Rest under foil 20 minutes before carving.
steps.note: Resting lets the juices settle back in.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C.
Pat {{ing:beef-topside}} dry. Rub with {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Sit on {{ing:onion-large}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 30 minutes. Turn the oven down to 180C.
Roast for the rest of 1 hour, until it is pink in the middle.
Rest under foil 20 minutes before carving.
steps.note: Resting lets the juices settle back in.

recipes.name: Slow-roast lamb with garlic and anchovy

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C.
Pat {{ing:lamb-leg}} dry. Rub with {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:anchovy-fillet}}.
Sit on {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} and {{ing:olive-oil}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 4 hours, until it falls from the bone.
Rest under foil 20 minutes before carving.
steps.note: Resting lets the juices settle back in.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C.
Pat {{ing:gammon-joint}} dry. Rub with {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:orange}}.
Sit on {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and {{ing:cloves}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 1 hour 30 minutes, until the glaze is sticky.
Rest under foil 15 minutes before carving.
steps.note: Resting lets the juices settle back in.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C.
Pat {{ing:pork-belly}} dry. Rub with {{ing:fennel-seeds}} and {{ing:salt}}.
Sit on {{ing:fennel-bulb}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 3 hours, until the meat is meltingly tender.
Rest under foil 15 minutes before carving.
steps.note: Resting lets the juices settle back in.

recipes.name: Pot-roast chicken with leeks and tarragon

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Pat {{ing:chicken-whole}} dry. Rub with {{ing:leek}} and {{ing:wine-white}}.
Sit on {{ing:fresh-tarragon}} and {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 1 hour 30 minutes, until the juices run clear.
Rest under foil 10 minutes before carving.
steps.note: Resting lets the juices settle back in.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C.
Pat {{ing:duck-leg}} dry. Rub with {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:star-anise}}.
Sit on {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:salt}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 1 hour 30 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the meat tender.
Rest under foil 5 minutes before carving.
steps.note: Resting lets the juices settle back in.

recipes.name: Roast turkey with sage and onion

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Pat {{ing:turkey-crown}} dry. Rub with {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:fresh-sage}}.
Sit on {{ing:onion-large}} and {{ing:lemon}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 1 hour 40 minutes, until the juices run clear.
Rest under foil 30 minutes before carving.
steps.note: Resting lets the juices settle back in.

recipes.name: Whole roast sea bream with lemon and fennel

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Lay {{ing:sea-bream}} in a roasting tin. Add {{ing:lemon}}, {{ing:fennel-bulb}}, {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:fresh-dill}}.
Roast 20 minutes, until the fish flakes.

recipes.name: Roast side of salmon with pesto crust

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Lay {{ing:salmon-fillet}} in a roasting tin. Add {{ing:pesto}}, {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} and {{ing:lemon}}.
Roast 15 minutes, until the fish flakes.

recipes.name: Roast cod with chorizo and butter beans

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Lay {{ing:cod-fillet}} in a roasting tin. Add {{ing:chorizo}}, {{ing:butter-beans-tinned}}, {{ing:cherry-tomato}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Roast 15 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Slice {{ing:potato-medium}} thinly. Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 25 minutes, until starting to crisp.
Lay {{ing:hake-fillet}} in a roasting tin. Add {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:capers}}.
Roast 15 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Lay {{ing:monkfish}} in a roasting tin. Add {{ing:pancetta}}, {{ing:fresh-sage}}, {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:lemon}}.
Roast 18 minutes, until the fish flakes.

recipes.name: Roast trout with almonds and herbs

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Lay {{ing:trout-fillet}} in a roasting tin. Add {{ing:almonds}}, {{ing:butter-unsalted}}, {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and {{ing:lemon}}.
Roast 12 minutes, until the fish flakes.

recipes.name: Roast rhubarb with orange and ginger

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:rhubarb}} as needed. Lay in a roasting tin.
Add {{ing:orange}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:ginger-ground}}.
Roast 15 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with {{ing:greek-yoghurt}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:pear}} as needed. Lay in a roasting tin.
Add {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:walnuts}}.
Roast 25 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with {{ing:creme-fraiche}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:figs-fresh}} as needed. Lay in a roasting tin.
Add {{ing:port}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Roast 15 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with {{ing:mascarpone}}.

recipes.name: Roast strawberries with balsamic and black pepper

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:strawberries}} as needed. Lay in a roasting tin.
Add {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.
Roast 12 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with {{ing:ice-cream-vanilla}}.

recipes.name: Roast apples with cinnamon and maple

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:apple-medium}} as needed. Lay in a roasting tin.
Add {{ing:maple-syrup}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Roast 25 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with {{ing:coconut-yoghurt}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:peach}} as needed. Lay in a roasting tin.
Add {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Roast 15 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with {{ing:double-cream}}.

recipes.name: Roast pineapple with lime and coconut

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:pineapple}} as needed. Lay in a roasting tin.
Add {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and {{ing:lime}}.
Roast 25 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with {{ing:coconut-yoghurt}}.

recipes.name: Roast grapes with ricotta and honey

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:grapes}} as needed. Lay in a roasting tin.
Add {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:ricotta}}.
Roast 15 minutes, until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with {{ing:honey}}.
